p: gate: Because he would inform Esther of this cruel proclamation.
arise to the Jews from another: Thus Mordecai spoke in the confidence of that faith which all God's children should have; which is that God will deliver them, though all worldly means fail.
such a time as this: To deliver God's Church out of these present dangers.
I perish: I will put my life in danger and refer the success to God, seeing it is for his glory and the deliverance of his Church.
